description: September 28 native Release measurements after JavaScript binding and benchmark resource reuse improvements; browser references remain from September 27.
notes: Individual benchmark reports are preserved verbatim. These are single-run reference measurements, not averaged regression thresholds.
Native and browser baselines are separate. No Node-plugin measurements have been pinned.
Scoring and fixed loads still use the historical ramp references; this baseline is only for result comparison.
